'''Bretton Kilvar''' is the mayor of [[Ostin Falls]].

== History ==
The Kilvars descend from a [[Domani]] merchant house, and have ruled the town of Ostin Falls on the border of [[Toman Head]] and [[Almoth Plain]] for around fifty years by {{ne|998}}. The town begins to decline with the hostilities between [[Tarabon]] and [[Arad Doman]] reducing trade in the region, which was exacerbated by the [[Seanchan]] occupation of [[Falme]]. Desperate to save the town from economic ruin or destruction, the mayor arranged a marriage between his son [[Lorwyn Kilvar|Lorwyn]] and [[Meka Antos]], the daughter of a merchant family from [[Bandar Eban]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
